text:
Type: southwestern patterned area rug
Use: colorful base for seating; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, contemporary
Materials: woven pile yarn
Colors: cream, magenta red, orange, navy, light blue
Shape: rectangular, rows of diamond motifs in stripes, zigzag edges, medium size, low pile
Feel: lively, warm, eclectic
Goes with: dark wood, woven baskets, white walls; boho or southwestern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Contemporary Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Multi
product.description: Bring a Southwestern flair into your home decor with this gorgeous rug. Bold diamond shapes rendered in rich colors create a captivating design that’s sure to capture attention wherever you place the rug in your home. 5' x 8' 100% polypropylene Machine made 0.75 High
